title: Ann and Tom
text:
Ann is very friendly. She smiles at everyone. She is also kind and helpful. Her friends like her a lot.

Tom is shy. He does not talk a lot in class. But Tom is very funny with his friends. He is also clever and good at math.

questions.text: What is Tom like in class?
options: He does not talk a lot

questions.text: What kind of person is Ann to her friends?
options: A person who is always alone

questions.text: Why might Tom be funny only with his friends?

vocabulary.definition: nice and easy to talk to
not comfortable talking to other people
able to learn and understand things quickly

paragraph_translations: Ann jest bardzo przyjazna. Uśmiecha się do wszystkich. Jest także miła i pomocna. Jej przyjaciele bardzo ją lubią.
Tom jest nieśmiały. Nie mówi dużo na lekcjach. Ale Tom jest bardzo zabawny ze swoimi przyjaciółmi. Jest też bystry i dobry z matematyki.
